chunks: Abu al-Bakhtari narrated from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
Helping a deaf person to hear without annoyance is a pleasant charity.

key_terms.إِسْمَاعُ: causing someone to hear; helping another perceive what is being said
key_terms.الْأَصَمِّ: the deaf person; one unable to hear
key_terms.صَدَقَةٌ: charity; a virtuous act done for the sake of Allah

ai.seo_question: Why is helping a deaf person patiently considered a form of charity in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that patiently assisting a deaf person is an act of charity. It highlights that kindness in service to others, especially without irritation or hardship in manner, carries moral and spiritual value.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3672 - Abu Al-Bakhtari narrated from Abu Abdillah (as) who said:
"Helping a deaf person to hear without annoyance is a pleasant charity."
